'''Summon Shantak''' is a [[spell]].  It first appeared in the [[Dunwich Horror]] expansion.

==Card info==
'''Casting Modifier''': -1

'''Sanity Cost''': 1

'''Movement Phase''': Cast and exhaust to gain 1 movement point.  In addition, you may leave or end your movement in spaces containing [[monster]]s without encountering the monsters this turn.
